description: Infrastructure agent that searches Terraform Registry, resolves DNS, checks SSL certificates, and looks up IP geolocation using OpenAI-compatible LLMs.
name: infrastructure_manager

skills.description: Search the Terraform Registry for modules. Returns module names, versions, descriptions, and download counts.
examples: Find a Terraform module for AWS VPC
Search for Terraform modules for EKS
skills.name: Terraform Module Search

skills.description: Get information about a Terraform provider from the registry. Returns version, description, source repository, downloads, and tier.
skills.name: Terraform Provider Info

skills.description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS) for any domain using Google's DNS-over-HTTPS.
examples: Look up MX records for example.com
skills.name: DNS Lookup

skills.description: Connect to a domain over TLS and inspect its certificate: issuer, subject, validity dates, days until expiry, and trust status.
skills.name: SSL Certificate Check

skills.description: Get geolocation and network information for an IP address: country, region, city, ISP, organization, AS number.
skills.name: IP Geolocation
